flow_notes: The film moves as a continuous drift from peace into dislocation and back to false peace. Sleeping head-down in mist leads into waking head-down on pavement for a dream-match. Searching glances carry left-to-right across city cuts toward the mountains, which motivates the turn into the crowded plaza. The crowd tightens from wide to close to overhead trap, then releases into the stillness of the crate. Harbour drift leads to park arrival, the glass reveal shock holds on flashes, then quiets into slow approaches to the painted forest, ending mirrored on the opening sleep pose as light dies.
